issues.message: Database schema includes a 'users' table with authentication fields (email, password_hash) but requirements specify only a single 'User' role with no authentication or multi-user functionality mentioned in any feature
Design includes Profile screen with logout functionality and user authentication UI elements, but requirements do not specify authentication, login, or user management features
No non-functional requirements defined for performance, security, scalability, or availability. Critical for production readiness
Foreign key relationship from tasks.user_id to users.id assumes multi-user system, but requirements only mention single 'User' role without multi-tenancy specification
Feature F4 mentions filtering tasks by status but does not specify if this is client-side or requires database indexing support
Design includes 'Account Settings' navigation item marked as future feature, creating scope ambiguity and potential user confusion
Schema includes updated_at timestamp fields but no trigger or application logic specified to maintain these automatically
Character count limit (0/500) shown in Create Task Modal but database schema uses TEXT type with no length constraint defined
Acceptance criteria for F3 mentions confirmation dialog but does not specify timeout or auto-dismiss behavior

required_fixes: Clarify whether the application is single-user or multi-user. If single-user, remove users table and authentication from database schema and design. If multi-user, add authentication and user management features to requirements

Add non-functional requirements covering: response time targets, concurrent user capacity, data retention policies, security requirements (authentication, authorization, data encryption), and availability targets
Align database schema with confirmed requirements - either add user authentication features to requirements or simplify schema to remove multi-user support
Remove or clearly mark Profile screen and authentication UI elements in design as out-of-scope if not in requirements, or add corresponding requirements if needed
Specify database trigger or application-level logic for maintaining updated_at timestamps in schema documentation
Define explicit validation rules for task description length limit and ensure consistency between design (500 char) and database schema (TEXT type)
recommendations: Add explicit non-functional requirements including: API response time < 200ms for task operations, support for at least 100 concurrent users, 99.9% uptime SLA, and data backup frequency
Include security requirements such as: password hashing algorithm (bcrypt with cost factor 12), session timeout duration, HTTPS enforcement, and SQL injection prevention measures
Add database migration strategy and versioning approach to technical requirements to support schema evolution
Consider adding soft-delete functionality to database schema (deleted_at timestamp) instead of hard deletion to support data recovery and audit trails
Define error handling strategy and user-facing error messages for common failure scenarios (network errors, validation failures, server errors)
Add accessibility testing requirements to ensure WCAG 2.1 AA compliance mentioned in design is validated
Specify data validation rules in requirements: maximum task title length, description length, allowed characters, and sanitization approach
Include performance budgets in design specifications: maximum bundle size, time to interactive, and first contentful paint targets for web application
